t: “Operations and research”, $500,000 of which $200,000 shall be derived from the Highway Trust Fund;

fable.w: This is a bare appropriation line specifying a dollar amount and its funding source. It involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision. The word "research" is only an account title and does not signal any outside-party process.
fable.s: “Operations and research”, $500,000 of which $200,000 shall be derived from the Highway Trust Fund;

qwen_block.w: This section is a simple appropriation clause specifying funding amounts and sources for operations and research. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public hearings, or requirements for outside input mentioned.
qwen_block.s: “Operations and research”, $500,000 of which $200,000 shall be derived from the Highway Trust Fund;

opus.w: This provision only sets a funding amount for an account and says what share comes from the Highway Trust Fund. It does not involve any party outside the federal government in a federal decision. The word "research" names a funding category, not a process for consulting outsiders, so it is not participation.
opus.s: “Operations and research”, $500,000 of which $200,000 shall be derived from the Highway Trust Fund;
opus.b: 1. **Tempting-but-wrong reading:** The word "research" might suggest outside experts are involved. That reading fails. This is just an appropriations line item that sets a dollar amount and says where part of it comes from. No one outside the federal government is consulted, given a hearing, put on an advisory board or given a right to sue over a decision.
